chunks: We will certainly help Our messengers and those who believe, in this world, and on the day the witnesses take their stand,

key_terms.يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْأَشْهَادُ: the day the witnesses take their stand

ai.seo_question: How does God support believers in this world and the Hereafter according to Surah Ghafir?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of 'Nasr' (divine victory) not merely as a future eschatological promise but as a continuous reality for the Ahl al-Bayt and the faithful, who endure persecution yet remain spiritually victorious. The phrase 'Day when witnesses will stand' is interpreted to include the testimony of the Prophets, Imams, and even creation itself, affirming the ultimate truth of the believers' cause against their detractors.
